title: Inception style dreams about dreaming, and explaining these dreamdreams to the other dream characters
content: Last night, dream-me made a good effort to discern whether things were real and "not some mallworld bullshit," (but it was) and concluded the jam-packed public restroom with the toilets right up against the short stall doors was definitely legit. Took me like 45 minutes or more to find the bathroom and use it and get back to my family out in the busy restaurant (in the bustling newly constructed end of my hometown). They were still there but had already eaten (I took way too long being tied up with a mundane task). I told someone the funny story of how the woman in line to exit the restroom, 6 inches from my face while I tried to use the toilet, made awkward direct eye contact with me! And I snidely told her "don't look into someone else's stall! " Can you imagine her embarrassment, with all those other people in line to hear it? I'm not usually one to say something like that so you know it was super rude of her.
